note: Five screens that are weak on purpose. They live outside src/ so they are never built, linted as product code or shipped. The reviewer must catch every one; `npm run review:fixtures` proves the deterministic first pass catches what it can.

screens.weakness: hard-coded colours and spacing instead of tokens
no error state: a failed load is swallowed and shows an empty list; no partial-failure state either
renders user-typed ad copy with v-html (XSS)
loads all 2,000 campaigns and filters them in the browser
bulk screen reports the successful items and drops the failed ones, then says Done
